snippet.title: The Watcher: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Watcher is a surveillance simulator set in a psychological thriller world. You play an unknown observer watching the residents of an apartment building across the street, in the strange city of Z, part of the totalitarian State of Nodia. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4982920/The_Watcher?utm_source=IGN&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_medium=article
